name: pidgeon
description: The trust layer for AI agents: Passport, Bouncer, Email and Auth, from one MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Identity and inboxes for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Give your agent an identity of its own: register it, make its key on your machine, and read its reputation, so the websites it visits can check who stands behind it. Give it an inbox too: addresses, conversations, sending and replies, and drafts held for your approval. Every tool goes through Pidgeon's hosted MCP server with your sign-in or API key, so the agent reaches only what that key reaches.
defaultPrompt: Register this agent with Pidgeon and make its key here.
What is my operator reputation on Pidgeon?
Make an inbox for this agent and wait for the verification email.
